theorems.name: SC recurrence finite and acyclic
theorems.statement: Any chain of macro edges, in particular any chain of SC->SC steps, from a state s has length at most 720 - popcount(orbit_masks(s)), and no state can recur along it.
theorems.answers: SEPARATE_CLEAR recurrence IS finite and acyclic: SC can repeat, but only finitely often and never in a cycle; every path terminates in R2 or DEAD after at most 720 macro edges
theorems.scope_note: holds for ALL residual mechanisms, not just SC
